panel.title: Anonymous usage statistics
panel.description: Off unless you turn it on. When on, ShekelSync sends small, anonymous events to Aptabase (a privacy-focused analytics service): when the app starts, when you open a screen, when you add an institution or a sync finishes, a once-a-day feature summary, and error types. No device ID or account is attached.
